{{Quote|Isard will be doing me a favor if she kills her.|Bors Kenlin, talking about his wife|<ref name="bacta" />}}
This [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' was the wife of [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Bors Kenlin]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].<ref name="bacta" />

During the [[Bacta War]], [[Ysanne Isard]], who seized control of the planet, issued a threat that the families of cargo tanker pilots would be [[Death/Legends|killed]] if the pilots surrendered their cargo of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who along with former members of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], were preying on delivery convoys. Despite the threat, Kenlin gladly surrendered his ship and cargo to Antilles. According to him, Isard would be doing him a favor by killing his wife.<ref name="bacta" />
